124:t_032:10.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

124:t_032:12.en:
$n
「I'll make you pay for this... without fail...!」

124:t_033:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Did we get him...!」

124:t_034:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Pathetic... This is nothing more than the most basic use of $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

124:t_035:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear...! This is not good at all!」

124:t_035:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, fall back! The poison is coming!」

124:t_036:1.en:
$n
「The nanomachines we were hit with, huh...!」

124:t_036:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This time it's a type that contaminates a much wider area. Everyone on this battlefield will be exposed to it.」

124:t_037:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It can't tell friend from foe!」

124:t_037:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ダブルオーライザー$$ can't deal with an area this wide...!」

124:t_037:3.en:
$$カツ$$
「Please wait! We can still fight!」

124:t_037:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If we hold on just a little longer, surely...」

124:t_037:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Withdraw. If you misjudge when to pull back, you'll cause something that can't be undone.」

124:t_037:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Cool your head! The fight doesn't end here!」

124:t_037:9.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, hurry and disengage! We'll give you the rendezvous point later!」

124:t_037:10.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$...」

124:t_037:12.en:
$n
「I'll make you pay for this... without fail...!」

124:t_038:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...What shall we do, $$バルビエル$$?」

124:t_038:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's obvious. I leave the rest to you, $$サルディアス$$.」

124:t_038:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then, as planned, I'll send out the pursuit force.」

124:t_038:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What fools. They could have just kept playing their little games at the $$ターミナル・ベース$$...」

124:t_038:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Learn the difference in class, Earthlings.」

124:t_039:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Four minutes into the operation! $$ティエリア$$'s unit has not reached the target point!」

124:t_039:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「At this rate the operation is a failure...! We have no choice but to withdraw!」

124:t_039:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I failed to live up to expectations...!」

124:t_040:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-What a disaster...! A blunder here is worth ten thousand deaths, and yet...!」

124:t_040:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fall back...! We have no choice but to bear the unbearable, endure the intolerable, and wait for a chance at revenge!」

124:t_041:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「A man who talks more than he needs to is a sorry sight.」

124:t_041:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「But guys like that are persistent. He's sure to show up in front of us again.」

124:t_100:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(The will of $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ sleeping within $$ヴェーダ$$... Something inside me is sounding an alarm...)

124:t_100:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(Was $$イオリア$$'s plan really complete with the emergence of the $$イノベイター$$...?)

124:t_100:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(To confirm that, too, I must take $$ヴェーダ$$ back into my own hands...!)

124:t_101:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
(Just you wait, $$サルディアス$$...! I'll make up for this mistake here and someday take your position...!)

124:t_101:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
($c...! To that end, you lot are going to be my stepping stones!)

124:t_102:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh...! So you're the famous Captain $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

124:t_102:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But of course...! You carry a more important role than you yourself imagine.」

124:t_102:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Neither I nor the Earth has time to indulge such nonsense...!」

124:t_102:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll fight as a single soldier to liberate the Earth, that's all!」

124:t_103:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... quite a skill you have. A technician of this caliber is rare even on a galactic scale.」

124:t_103:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is this guy playing around...!?」

124:t_103:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I don't have the slightest room to play around with a first-rate pilot like you.」

124:t_103:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If I do seem to have room to spare, that must be the wisdom of age.」

124:t_103:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's dangerous to be drawn into his pace...! This man is no mere joker!」

124:t_103:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Haha... thank you for giving me so much credit.」

124:t_104:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And now another unusual machine appears...! This planet is like a jack-in-the-box!」

124:t_104:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you talking about the $$ユニコーン$$...!」

124:t_104:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As I thought, you seem unaware. You people should learn a little more about how unique you are.」

124:t_104:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「And while you're at it, please admit soon that resisting is futile.」

124:t_104:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't be swayed by words like that! As long as any chance remains, I'll fight with everything I have!」

124:t_105:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I see... Meeting someone like you, the reason the $$サイデリアル$$ invaded makes sense to me.」

124:t_105:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, no... I'm just a humble middle manager in the field. I wouldn't know the real truth.」

124:t_105:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But let me say this much. Someone like you is hope and, at the same time, despair.」

124:t_106:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hoho... so you're the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$ I've heard about.」

124:t_106:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, it's just... believe it or not, I've had quite a connection with Reactors...」

124:t_106:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As wide as the galaxy is, I may be the only person who has actually met this many Reactors.」

124:t_106:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, how scary. Youth that knows no fear is a frightening thing.」

124:t_106:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you don't seem to have mastered the $$スフィア$$ at all yet. That's a relief.」

124:t_106:7.en:
$n
「What do you know about my $$スフィア$$! I'll shut that busy mouth of yours!」

124:t_107:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「I know, $$ゼロ$$. In $$新日本$$, $$藤堂$$ and the others are holding out hard for us...」

124:t_107:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「For the sake of the people of $$新日本$$, we'll strike down the heart of the $$新地球皇国$$ as soon as we can...!」

124:t_107:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「There is nothing left for me to say.」

124:t_107:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But don't forget. Until the day that wish is granted, we are not permitted to fall...!」

124:t_107:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We are $$ゼロ$$! Receiving the people's wishes, we will work a miracle!」

124:t_108:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「I won't forgive them...! I'll never forgive you, $$サイデリアル$$!」

124:t_108:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Calm down, $$カレン$$. This is not an enemy you can beat if you lose your composure.」
